font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<div style=\"font-size:0\"><span style=\"font-size:14px\">restored and visible</span></div>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
